title: OUTAGE
description: PSX psychological horror for Steam, Team Indie Bindie.
overview:
## OUTAGE

A story-driven psychological horror game in a retro PSX and VHS style, made with Team Indie Bindie. Noah ran from his past and his sins, but they had other plans for him. The first part is playable on itch.io, and the full game is coming to Steam.

title: That's a Weird Night
description: A short third-person stealth level in the spirit of Hitman. Lanark, 1297: one night, one garrison, three prisoners to get out without a fight.
overview:
## That's a Weird Night

Summer 1297. The English hold Lanark with a garrison and a dungeon under its keep, and three Scots wait in that hole for the rope. You come down out of the trees at night to get them out, and you are no fighter. A short third-person stealth level in the spirit of Hitman: read the guards, slip past them, wear their colours and turn the garrison's own night against it. About 15 to 30 minutes, playable in the browser.

### Core Mechanics
- **Instinct**: hold Q to see guards through walls, where they walk and where you can hide.
- **Disguises**: take a guard down from behind and wear his uniform, but the men of his own unit know his face.
- **Bodies**: drag them out of the light; a body found raises the alarm.
- **Light and cover**: barley and shadow hide you, torches and braziers give you away, and lights can be put out.
- **The escape**: steal the jailer's keys, free the prisoners and let the riot cover your ride out of the gate.

### Level Design
The level was planned with **[Encounter Lens](/projects/encounter-lens)**, a Unity tool I built for it. It reads every guard, light, piece of cover and hiding place in the scene and paints how likely the player is to be seen at each step of a route, so each zone could be tuned against a target before anyone played it.

![The garrison from above: the intended route in blue, guards and their sightlines, and the risk of being seen in red.](/images/projects/thats-a-weird-night/encounter-lens-map.jpg)

![Tension along the route: each zone has a target band (green), the red line is what the tool measures.](/images/projects/thats-a-weird-night/encounter-lens-tempo.png)

- **Read at a glance**: every gap between buildings is either closed or at least 2 m wide, so the player always knows what fits.
- **A tower as a compass**: the dungeon tower is visible from everywhere, and from the hill path it lines up with the crawl hole in the wall.
- **Cover with a rhythm**: the barley field leaves a 5 m open run in front of the wall, timed against a guard's 12.5 m patrol.
- **More than one way in**: the crawl hole under the palisade, the village rooftops and the wall walk.
- **Story in the set dressing**: the garrison is under repair, with rubble, plank stacks, a rebel stash and names scratched on the dungeon wall.

Every step of the build, from the first greybox to the dressed night level, can be scrubbed through in the Build Replay on the [Encounter Lens](/projects/encounter-lens) page.

title: Analoglu Architecture
description: A PSX horror simulation made for TEDU Jam 2026. You are a building inspector: approve or reject proposals by the rule book. Doing everything right does not mean everything will be fine.
overview:
## Analoglu Architecture

A PSX horror simulation made for TEDU Jam 2026. You play a building inspector at a cramped desk, reading proposals and stamping them approved or rejected according to the rule book. Doing everything right does not mean everything will be fine.

### Core Mechanics
- **Inspection**: Click a document to read it up close, right click to zoom into the details.
- **The rule book**: Every decision is checked against the rules on your desk.
- **Stamping**: Equip the stamp, then approve or reject each proposal.
- **Desk view**: Click the map to switch to a top-down view of the whole desk.

### Team
Made with RoderOne, Kelebek and MagpieWing in Godot.

title: Where is Azrael?
description: Solo project featuring a custom dialog system, boss fight, and environment design in a medieval pixel-art world.
overview:
## Where is Azrael?

A personal project exploring deep narrative systems and combat mechanics in Unity.

### Implementation Details
- **Dialog System**: Branching narrative with state-dependent responses.
- **Boss Fight**: Systems-driven combat encounter.
- **Environment Design**: Storytelling through spatial layout.

title: A Dance of Destruction
description: A 48-hour GMTK Game Jam 2024 entry. Eat planets and meteorites in space, but don't eat Earth.
overview:
## A Dance of Destruction

Created in 48 hours for GMTK Game Jam 2024. A 3D space action game where you eat planets and meteorites to grow, but protect Earth at all costs.

### Gameplay
- **Core Loop**: Eat objects to grow, but don't exceed the size limit.
- **White Holes**: Use them to shrink back down.
- **Tasks**: Complete objectives while managing your size.

### Team
Collaborative jam entry with RogueLime, dibrojga, Bilaxten, RoderOne, and HonorAlp.

title: OverClocked!
description: A simulation game where you play as a robot worker converting raw materials into products before your battery runs out.
overview:
## OverClocked!

A jam entry for Winter is JAMing. You're a robot in a factory, converting raw materials into products as demanded by the CEO.

### Gameplay
- **Core Loop**: Process materials on the conveyor belt and deliver products.
- **Battery System**: Completing orders recharges you; pulling levers drains charge.
- **Organic Converter**: Handle strange materials carefully.

### Team
Collaborative entry with 3kmek, dibrojga, RoderOne, and loravu.

title: overgrown
description: A Lovecraftian-themed management and simulation game. Grow plants in your greenhouse and sell them before they grow out of control.
overview:
## overgrown

A Lovecraftian-themed management and simulation prototype. Sell the plants you grow to unlock new plant types and developments.

### Core Mechanics
- **Seed Planting**: Plant seeds from an endless store into empty pots.
- **Irrigation**: Water plants with blood from a barrel.
- **Harvesting**: Harvest on time or plants enter the 'overgrown' stage.
- **Overgrown**: Each plant has a unique overgrown trait that activates if not harvested in time.
- **Selling**: Deliver plants, earn money, pay rent, and buy upgrades.

### Team
Collaborative project with Osman Gelmez, RogueLime, and dibrojga.

title: CardTower GDD
description: Comprehensive Game Design Document for a mobile card tower defense game, created during internship at UDO Games.
overview:
## Overview

CardTower is a GDD for a mobile-first card tower defense hybrid. Players draw cards each turn to place towers, cast spells, and adapt to procedurally generated enemy waves.

## Key Systems

- Card draw and hand management
- Tower placement and synergy system
- Economy and upgrade loop
- Procedural difficulty scaling

## Design Philosophy

The goal was to create a game that rewards planning without punishing beginners. Each design decision was tested against three player archetypes: casual, mid-core, and competitive.

title: Encounter Lens
description: A Unity level design tool I built for That's a Weird Night: it paints the risk of being seen, plots the tension along a route and scores encounter difficulty, with a Build Replay of the level's construction.
overview:
## Encounter Lens

A Unity editor tool I built while designing That's a Weird Night, to check a stealth level on paper before anyone plays it. It reads every guard (type, facing, patrol), light, piece of cover and solid wall in the scene, using the same vision numbers as the enemy AI at runtime.

### What it does
- **Heat map**: paints the risk of being seen on the floor of the Scene view.
- **Tension along the route**: samples that risk along the intended route and plots it, zone by zone, against a target band for each zone. A zone that is too hard or too easy shows at once.
- **Zones and side routes**: draw a zone in the Scene view and give it a target; side routes into a zone count toward its peak.
- **Encounter area pen**: click the corners of an area on the ground and get a difficulty score from the enemies, herbs and space inside it, live in the Scene view and the Inspector.
- **Build history**: one click saves a snapshot of the whole blockout with a note on the design decision behind it.

![The garrison in the Scene view: the intended route in blue, guards and their sightlines, and the risk of being seen in red.](/images/projects/encounter-lens/heatmap.jpg)

![Tension along the route: each zone has a target band (green), the red line is what the tool measures.](/images/projects/encounter-lens/tempo.png)

### Build Replay
The 20 snapshots saved while building the level, played back in the browser: from a single ground plane to the dressed night level. Step through the timeline, switch on Diff to see what was added, moved or removed, and draw an encounter area with the pen to see how that fight changed across every build. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom.
